_instructions: REQUIRED: Configure your capability map, qualification criteria, CRM database IDs, enrichment provider, and delivery destination for Capture Team (Chet, Kipp, Ben). 'icp_profiles' below covers any pursuit-qualification type -- business-development ICP, GovCon eligibility/capability alignment, or grant eligibility/program alignment -- just fill in the criteria fields for whichever applies to you; the schema doesn't change. Notion and Google Drive fields below are illustrative -- rename/restructure to match whatever CRM and storage you actually use. Update whenever your capture process changes.

capability_map._instructions: One entry per placement-capable capability, for Chet's cluster discovery.

scanning._instructions: Sources Chet scans for new signals, and the minimum group size to qualify as a cluster.
scanning.gap_volume_threshold: [e.g. 3 -- minimum member count for a group to qualify]

icp_profiles.label: [e.g. 'Government contractor, 10-200 employees' -- or a grant/funding profile like 'Community nonprofit, education programs', or a GovCon profile like 'Set-aside eligible, NAICS 541611']
icp_profiles.size_range: [e.g. 10-200 employees or a revenue range -- leave blank if not applicable to this profile type]
classification_criteria: [Signal or field that qualifies a record for this profile -- e.g. NAICS/certification alignment, program eligibility, geography, deadline, or whatever your pursuit type actually requires]

routing_flags._instructions: How Kipp's classified records get routed after intake.

notion._instructions: Named 'notion' for illustration only -- if you use a different CRM (Airtable, HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.), rename these keys and adapt the ID format to match.

enrichment._instructions: Kipp's contact/company enrichment provider and key.
enrichment.provider: [e.g. Hunter.io, Clearbit, Apollo, or whatever you use]
enrichment.api_key_env_var: [NAME OF YOUR ENV VAR -- never paste the key itself here]

delivery._instructions: Where Ben's finished briefs land. Named for Google Drive for illustration only -- use whatever storage location (OneDrive, SharePoint, etc.) and identifier your own tool needs.

brief_structure._instructions: Section headers for Ben's brief output. Customize to your delivery format.
